meta.task: I want to listen to music

defs.name: Music Player: Search Bar
defs.genInstructions: Build a top search bar with a text input and instant results dropdown that lets the user search the music library by song, artist, album, or playlist. Filters what the Library Browser shows in real time.
defs.role: The entry point for finding music, driving the Library Browser to show only content matching the user's query.

targets.name: Music Player: Library Browser
targets.description: As the user types (debounced keystrokes) or submits a query, emit the current search string; the Library Browser re-queries its catalog and re-renders only tracks/albums/artists/playlists whose metadata matches the query. Clearing the field restores the full unfiltered library.

defs.name: Music Player: Library Browser
defs.genInstructions: Build the main content area as a scrollable grid/list of albums, artists, playlists, and tracks with cover art and metadata, plus tabs to switch between these views. Serves as the primary place to browse and pick music.
defs.role: The central browsing surface where the user explores the collection and chooses what to play or enqueue, feeding both the player and the queue.

effectors.name: Music Player: Search Bar
effectors.description: Receives the current search string from the Search Bar; filters and re-renders the grid/list to show only items matching the query, or the full library when cleared.

targets.name: Music Player: Now Playing Bar
targets.description: When the user double-clicks or hits play on a track/album, emit that track (and its containing collection) as the new current track; the Now Playing Bar loads it, starts playback, and updates its transport state.

targets.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
targets.description: When the user chooses 'Add to Queue' or plays an album/playlist, emit the ordered list of track IDs; the Queue Side Panel appends or replaces its queue with those tracks.

defs.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a right-side panel listing upcoming tracks in play order with drag-to-reorder, remove buttons, and a highlight on the currently playing track. Lets the user manage what plays next.
defs.role: The playback order manager that holds and lets the user reorder upcoming tracks, supplying the next track to the player and reflecting the player's current position.

effectors.name: Music Player: Library Browser
effectors.description: Receives ordered track ID lists when the user adds an item or plays a collection; appends them to the queue or replaces the queue accordingly.

effectors.name: Music Player: Now Playing Bar
effectors.description: When the player advances (track ends, next/previous pressed), receives the new current-track index; scrolls to and highlights that track and removes consumed tracks from the up-next list.

targets.name: Music Player: Now Playing Bar
targets.description: When the user clicks a queued track or reorders the queue, emit the newly selected/next track; the Now Playing Bar loads and plays it and syncs its next/previous targets to the new order.

defs.name: Music Player: Now Playing Bar
defs.genInstructions: Build a fixed bottom transport bar with play/pause, next/previous, a seekable progress bar with time labels, shuffle/repeat toggles, a volume slider, and compact current-track info. This is the core playback controller.
defs.role: The central playback engine and control surface that governs the current track, transport state, and volume, coordinating the queue and the art panel.

effectors.name: Music Player: Library Browser
effectors.description: Receives a track (and its collection) selected for immediate play; loads it as the current track and begins playback, updating all transport controls.

effectors.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
effectors.description: Receives a track selected or reordered in the queue; loads and plays it and aligns next/previous behavior to the queue order.

targets.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
targets.description: On track end or next/previous press, emit the advanced current-track index so the queue highlights the new track and drops consumed entries.

targets.name: Music Player: Now Playing Art Panel
targets.description: On every current-track change and play/pause/seek event, emit the track's cover art, title, artist, album, and playback progress; the Art Panel updates its large artwork, metadata, and any progress visualization.

defs.name: Music Player: Now Playing Art Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a large focal panel showing the current track's full-size cover art, title, artist, album name, and an optional animated visualizer or lyrics area. Provides an immersive view of what's playing.
defs.role: The visual centerpiece that showcases the currently playing track in detail, driven entirely by the Now Playing Bar's playback state.

effectors.name: Music Player: Now Playing Bar
effectors.description: Receives the current track's cover art, title, artist, album, and live playback progress on every track change and play/pause/seek event; updates the large artwork, metadata text, and visualizer accordingly.
